method.description: The HTTP method to be used for the API call.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request.

Content-Type.description: The media type of the resource being requested or submitted.

body.description: The JSON payload to be sent with POST, PUT, or PATCH requests.

Sure thing! Finding a three‑bedroom flat in Zürich can feel overwhelming because there’s so much competition—but with a clear plan you’ll cut through the noise quickly. Below I’ve broken it down into four steps: | Step | What to Do | Why It Helps | |------|------------|--------------| | **1️⃣ Clarify Your Must‑Haves** | • Budget (rent + utilities)
• Desired district(s): e.g. Mitte, Seefeld, Oerlikon, Zollikon
• Move‑in window (immediate vs. next month)
• Building age / amenities (elevator, parking, balcony, pet policy)
• Proximity to public transport, schools, parks | Knowing exactly what matters lets you filter early and avoid wasting time on unsuitable options. | | **2️⃣ Use Dedicated Swiss Property Portals** | • [Homegate](https://www.homegate.ch/) – most comprehensive list, advanced filtering.
• [ImmoScout24](https://www.immoscout24.ch/zh/home.html) – great for comparing prices across districts.
• [Comparis Immobilien](https://www.comparis.ch/immobilien) – price comparison tool plus alerts.
• Local Facebook groups & “Zürcher Wohnungsbörse” pages – often have last‑minute deals. | These sites aggregate almost all new listings and let you set up email/SMS alerts tailored to your criteria. | | **3️⃣ Leverage Real‑Time Alerts & Agents** | • Sign up for *“New Listings”* notifications on each portal.
• Set Google Alert for keywords (“3 Zimmer Wohnung Zürich”, “Wohnung mit Balkon Zürich”).
• Contact local agencies—many specialize in furnished rentals and can pre‑qualify units before they hit the market. | You get first dibs when something fits your profile pops up, saving you hours of scrolling. | | **4️⃣ Prepare Your Application Kit** | • Copy of passport/passport photo
• Proof of income (last 3 payslips or contract)
• Employment letter or self‑employment invoice
• Bank statement showing monthly balance
• Reference letters (previous landlord, employer)
• Rental guarantee (if required) | Having everything ready means you can submit instantly once you spot a match—a huge advantage in competitive markets. | --- ### Quick Start Checklist | Item | Action | Tool | |------|--------|------| | **Budget** | Decide max rent including utility surcharge (~10–15 % of base rent). | Spreadsheet or budgeting app | | **District Filter** | Pick top 2–3 neighborhoods based on commute/time preference. | Map view on portals | | **Alert Setup** | Create accounts → Settings → Notifications → New Listing Filters. | Portal UI | | **Application Pack** | Print PDFs, keep digital copies. | Cloud storage (Google Drive, Dropbox) | | **Contact Agent** | Draft concise inquiry template. | Email client | #### Sample Inquiry Template ``` Subject: Interest in 3‑Zimmer Apartment at [Address] – Immediate Availability Dear [Agent Name], My name is [Your Full Name], currently employed as [Job Title] at [Company]. I am looking for a 3‑bedroom rental in Zürich, ideally within [desired districts], with a move‑in date around [date]. Attached please find my application documents: - Passport copy - Latest salary slip - Employer reference letter - Recent bank statement Could you kindly confirm availability, lease terms, and whether additional documentation is required? Thank you very much for your assistance. Best regards, [Phone Number] [Email Address] ``` --- ### If You Want Automation If you'd prefer to pull fresh listings automatically, many portals offer unofficial RSS feeds or simple GET endpoints. For example, Homegate has a `search` endpoint where you can specify parameters: ```python import json, urllib.parse, urllib.request def homegate_search(bedrooms=3, min_price=None, max_price=None): params = { 'propertyType': 'apartment', 'minRooms': bedrooms, 'maxPrice': max_price, # add more filters here... } url = f"https://homegate.ch/api/search?" + urllib.parse.urlencode(params) req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'Accept':'application/json'}) with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as resp: return json.loads(resp.read().decode()) results = homegate_search(max_price=2500) print(results['listings']) ``` *(Note: this is illustrative only; check the official API docs or contact support.)* --- ### Final Tips 1. **Act Fast:** In Zürich, good 3‑bed flats disappear in days. Once you see one that matches, apply immediately. 2. **Be Flexible With Districts:** Expanding your radius slightly can uncover hidden gems at lower rents. 3. **Use Public Transport Maps:** Check S-Bahn/NFC coverage near potential addresses—you’ll save commuting headaches later. 4. **Ask About Utility Costs Early:** Some landlords include heating/water in the rent; others charge separately. 5. **Consider Shared Ownership Options:** Co‑ownership schemes sometimes allow larger apartments at reduced costs. Good luck hunting! Feel free to share your exact budget, preferred districts, or any other constraints—and I can tailor the advice even further.
